title: Satisfiable cut instances are fully satisfied
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, and let $P$ be a maximum-cut constraint instance on $V$ with a nonempty multiset of constraints in which every variable occurs in the scope of some constraint. If the optimum value of $P$ is $1$, then an optimal assignment satisfies every constraint of $P$.
hypotheses_covered: Every variable occurs in the scope of some constraint
The optimum value of the instance is $1$
